create_mmmu_vlm_eval: create an MMMU VLM evaluation instance with configurable sample count and thread pool
build_chat_messages_from_prompt: build chat messages from a prompt string and base64 image data for VLM inference
run_mmmu_evaluation: run the MMMU VLM evaluation against a sampler and return per-domain accuracy results

parse_open_response: parse an open-ended model response to extract normalized answer candidates
